about: How many sellable slots each stadium surface has (the Marketplace's Pick your slots; lib/office/slots.mjs reads it). A slot is one logo on one panel: the whole-texture surfaces (the field walls, the wall wrap, the tunnel) are split into panels, so one brand's logo sits on the school's own colours. `defaults` apply to every stadium; `stadiums.<key>` (matched by the Story desk's stadium name, or the school) overrides a count, the slot names or the colours. A surface left out here (the club row's logo sheet, the video board's panels) is sold whole, as one slot. `sold: false` is shown but not sold yet, with `why`. Every count is a guess until it's checked on the PC against the real meshes (`checkOnPc`).
